lines.zh: 我找不到头，但我不会停止。
lines.en: No head, but I won't stop.

lines.zh: 在这片灼热的沙地游荡。

lines.en: Searching for prey in the firelight.

lines.zh: 警惕四周，敌人可能潜藏。

lines.en: Flames surround me, never to fade.

lines.zh: 燃烧的皮革是我的武器。
下界合金碎片是我的战利品。

lines.en: Headless, yet my hooves know the way.

lines.zh: 鬃毛燃着火，沿岩道奔跑。
lines.en: Mane ablaze, I run along the stone road.
Waiting for prey, patient as fire.
In the heat, I remain motionless.
In flames, I wait in silence.
Your scent, I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我没有头，却知道你站哪儿。
lines.en: Headless, and I still know where you stand.

lines.zh: 我没有头，可我记得你的路。
lines.en: I have no head, yet I remember your path.
Player, I'm going to eat you.

lines.zh: 颈口的热气先喷到你脸上。
lines.en: Heat from my neck stump hits your face first.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，人类，我的蹄子饥渴了！
lines.en: Sssss, human, my hooves are hungry!

lines.zh: 你手里那点草料，闻着不错。
lines.en: That fodder in your hand smells decent.
What delicious food do you hold?
Feel the sharpness of my teeth!

lines.zh: 我的蹄子比你的剑更锐利！
lines.en: My hooves are sharper than your sword!
Don't dodge, my hooves are fast!

lines.zh: 我的蹄子在你身边刨出火星。
lines.en: My hooves paw sparks beside you.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，我必须撞你！
lines.en: You're blocking me, I must knock you down!

lines.zh: 马蹄踏在你脚边，火星四溅。
lines.en: A hoof stamps by your feet, sparks flying.

lines.zh: 没有头，我也认得出同类的蹄声。
lines.en: Headless, I still know a fellow's hooves.

lines.zh: 另一串蹄声，在岩道那头。
lines.en: Another set of hooves sounds down the stone road.

lines.zh: 没有头，我照样听得出蹄声。
lines.en: Headless, and I still know a hoofbeat.

lines.zh: 举着火跑过岩浆边，没人应。
lines.en: I run blazing past the lava, and no one answers.

lines.zh: 这片燃烧的大地是我的！

lines.en: Stay back, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 燃烧的地狱碎片是我的财富！
没有头，我照样追你到火里。
lines.en: Headless, and I still chase you into fire.

lines.zh: 你的末影珍珠对我无用！
lines.en: Your Ender Pearls won't save you!

lines.zh: 燃烧的地狱之火在我心中！
lines.en: Burning Nether fire in my heart!

lines.zh: 我的触角比你想象的更长！
lines.en: My tentacles are longer than you think!

lines.zh: 下界合金碎片是我的荣耀！
我是无头骡，你的噩梦开始！
lines.en: I'm the Headless Mule, your nightmare begins!

lines.zh: 汗味里混着铁，我记住了。
lines.en: Your sweat smells of iron. I have it.

lines.zh: 蹄印在热沙上，一直通向你。
lines.en: Hoofprints run across the hot sand straight to you.

lines.zh: 你的末地宝石也救不了你！
我能看到你的一举一动！
lines.en: I can see your every move!

lines.zh: 火光照出你的轮廓，够了。
lines.en: The firelight shows your shape. That is enough.

lines.zh: 没有眼睛，我也闻到你了。
lines.en: No eyes, yet I smell you.
The hoofbeats stop, right behind you.
Heat blasts from the stump of my neck.
Standing still makes this too easy.

lines.zh: 鬃毛烧旺了，我压低前蹄。
lines.en: My mane flares; I lower my forehooves.

lines.zh: 你的末地玫瑰是无用的！

lines.en: Your End swords can't hurt me!

lines.zh: 我的触角比你想象的更致命！
lines.en: My tentacles are more deadly than you think!

lines.zh: 你的末地之魂救不了你！
lines.en: Your End soul won't save you!
I have no head, but my hooves know the way.

lines.zh: 我看不见，可我能听出你的步子。
lines.en: I cannot see, but I can hear your stride.

lines.zh: 火焰顺着鬃毛烧到你面前。
lines.en: Fire runs down my mane to your face.

lines.zh: 退到岩壁边，你没地方躲。
lines.en: Back to the rock wall, you have nowhere to go.
This hoof goes for your knee.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着逼近，准备攻击。
lines.en: Snort and advance, ready to attack.
Snort and ready to kick you.
My hind hooves kick out, straight into your chest.

lines.zh: 燃烧的鬃毛扫过你的手臂。
lines.en: My burning mane sweeps across your arm.
My forehooves come down, and the ground cracks.
I smash your shield aside in a spray of sparks.

lines.zh: 岩浆边响起没有来源的嘶鸣。
lines.en: A whinny with no source sounds by the lava.

lines.zh: 火焰聚成马身，踏碎岩壳。
lines.en: Flames gather into a horse shape and break the rock crust.

lines.zh: 火伤不了我，我本来就在烧。
lines.en: Fire cannot hurt me; I was already burning.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，蹄子还在刨。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, yet my hooves still paw.

lines.zh: 魔法在皮上烧出蓝色痕迹。
lines.en: Magic burns blue marks into my hide.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，鬃毛烧得更旺。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and my mane burns brighter.
